introduction: Illinois IDES handles unemployment claims through its online system. An initial claim and later benefit certifications are separate steps.
description: Illinois IDES handles unemployment claims through its online system. An initial claim and later benefit certifications are separate steps.

sections.who: IDES reviews work history and the reason employment ended, then checks continuing eligibility. Read the claim finding and next-step instructions; filing alone does not approve benefits.
sections.get: Eligible unemployment benefits provide temporary income. The agency’s July 2026 notice says payments use direct deposit or a debit card rather than paper checks.
sections.docs:
• Identification and contact details.
  • Employer, work-date and earnings information.
  • Your ILogin credentials.
  • Work-search and earnings records for ongoing certifications.
sections.apply:
1. Start through IDES

    Use File an Unemployment Claim and review the preparation instructions.

  2. Keep the account secure

    Create or use the required ILogin account.

  3. Certify as scheduled

    Use the designated certification day and report work and earnings accurately.
sections.after: Read Eligibility & Next Steps after filing. If you miss the designated day, the certification page lists Thursday and Friday make-up options.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using current payment notice, claim filing, certification options, claim eligibility and next steps. The administering organization decides eligibility.

faqs: IDES lists Tele-Serve at 312-338-4337 as an alternative certification route.
